description: Connect Cartly+ to manage your household shopping lists from a conversation. Add a single item or up to 50 recipe ingredients at once, check your list, adjust quantities, mark items as bought, and remove items you no longer need. Cartly+ uses your active household unless you ask for another one. Changes sync with your Cartly account. A Cartly account and authorization are required. Recipe ingredients are added only when you ask.

defaultPrompt: Show my shopping list for today.
Add milk and bread to my shopping list.
Add the ingredients from this recipe to my shopping list.
